title: Nostradamus' Tomb
summary: Nostradamus' Tomb is the resting place of the Casterwill family seer, Nostradamus. It is hidden deep beneath a forest of red-leaved trees in Salon Graveyard and can only be opened by stabbing the Willblade into the ground.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Nostradamus was buried in the tomb, but opted to keep his resting place a secret for risk of it being looted by grave robbers. [Words from Eathon]

On the longest night of the year, Dante Vale and his team, instructed by Eathon Lambert and a secret file on his Holotome, travelled to Salon Graveyard to find Nostradamus' last quatrain, their only clue being a "tree with red leaves". When they arrived, they were perplexed and frustrated to find a whole woodland of identical trees but when Lok stumbled and the Willblade landed in the foot a tree, the ground opened presenting a series of winding steps all leading to the tomb. It became clear that Nostradamus had wanted the Willblade's owner to have full access to his tomb. In the coffin, the team found the quatrain "Into the Spiral centre, the Champion of Casterwill will fly; only the Fire of Justice will cause the long night to die." The team were then attacked by Marduk and his Casterwill Hunters but managed to teleport away to the Spiral Mark using Umbra. [Words from Eathon]

'''Nostradamus' Tomb''' is the resting place of the [[Casterwill family]] seer, [[Nostradamus]]. It is hidden deep beneath a forest of red-leaved trees in [[Salon Graveyard]] and can only be opened by stabbing the [[Willblade]] into the ground. 

== History ==
Nostradamus was buried in the tomb, but opted to keep his resting place a secret for risk of it being looted by grave robbers. {{source|Words from Eathon}}

On the longest night of the year, [[Dante Vale]] and his team, instructed by [[Eathon Lambert]] and a secret file on his [[Holotome]], travelled to Salon Graveyard to find Nostradamus' last quatrain, their only clue being a "tree with red leaves". When they arrived, they were perplexed and frustrated to find a whole woodland of identical trees but when Lok stumbled and the Willblade landed in the foot a tree, the ground opened presenting a series of winding steps all leading to the tomb. It became clear that Nostradamus had wanted the Willblade's owner to have full access to his tomb. In the coffin, the team found the quatrain "Into the Spiral centre, the [[Lok Lambert|Champion of Casterwill]] will fly; only the   [[Phoenix|Fire of Justice]] will cause the long night to die." The team were then attacked by [[Marduk]] and his [[Casterwill Hunters]] but managed to teleport away to the [[Spiral Mark]] using [[Umbra]]. {{source|Words from Eathon}}
